{"program":"domain(person,[bunny,aileen,giovanni,estella]).
% Bunny performs ballet.
axiom(s1, performs(bunny,ballet)).
% Either Aileen enjoys tango or she dislikes tango, but not both.
axiom(s2, xor(enjoys(aileen,tango), dislikes(aileen,tango))).
% Giovanni has stage experience.
axiom(s3, has(giovanni,stage_experience)).
% If Aileen has grace, then she performs rumba and expresses passion.
axiom(s4, rule([has(aileen,grace)], and(performs(aileen,rumba), expresses(aileen,passion)))).
% If Aileen has stage experience, then she either performs ballet or performs rumba, but not both.
axiom(s5, rule([has(aileen,stage_experience)], xor(performs(aileen,ballet), performs(aileen,rumba)))).
% If Aileen has rhythm, then she instructs movement and shares her passion.
axiom(s6, rule([has(aileen,rhythm)], and(instructs(aileen,movement), shares(aileen,passion)))).
% Giovanni values culture.
axiom(s7, values(giovanni,culture)).
% If Aileen is a choreographer, then she either practices yoga or teaches dance, but not both.
axiom(s8, rule([choreographer(aileen)], xor(practices(aileen,yoga), teaches(aileen,dance)))).
% If Aileen either performs rumba or dances samba (but not both), then she teaches dance.
axiom(s9, rule([xor(performs(aileen,rumba), dances(aileen,samba))], teaches(aileen,dance))).
% Aileen performs ballet.
axiom(s10, performs(aileen,ballet)).
% If Giovanni instructs movement, then she either loves waltz or loves salsa, but not both.
axiom(s11, rule([instructs(giovanni,movement)], xor(loves(giovanni,waltz), loves(giovanni,salsa)))).
% Either Bunny enjoys tango or she dislikes tango, but not both.
axiom(s12, xor(enjoys(bunny,tango), dislikes(bunny,tango))).
% If Aileen instructs movement, then she either loves waltz or loves salsa, but not both.
axiom(s13, rule([instructs(aileen,movement)], xor(loves(aileen,waltz), loves(aileen,salsa)))).
% If Aileen teaches dance, then she either loves salsa or enjoys tango, but not both.
axiom(s14, rule([teaches(aileen,dance)], xor(loves(aileen,salsa), enjoys(aileen,tango)))).
% For all humans, if they either attend tango clubs or listen to tango music (but not both), then they enjoy tango.
axiom(s15, forall(var(x,person), implies(xor(attends(var(x),tango_clubs), listens(var(x),tango_music)), enjoys(var(x),tango)))).
% Bunny appreciates music.
axiom(s16, appreciates(bunny,music)).
% Aileen dances samba.
axiom(s17, dances(aileen,samba)).
% Aileen appreciates music.
axiom(s18, appreciates(aileen,music)).
% Aileen values culture.
axiom(s19, values(aileen,culture)).
% Aileen loves waltz.
axiom(s20, loves(aileen,waltz)).
% If Bunny either performs rumba or dances samba (but not both), then she teaches dance.
axiom(s21, rule([xor(performs(bunny,rumba), dances(bunny,samba))], teaches(bunny,dance))).
% If Aileen appreciates music, then she instructs movement and values culture.
axiom(s22, rule([appreciates(aileen,music)], and(instructs(aileen,movement), values(aileen,culture)))).
% Estella loves waltz.
axiom(s23, loves(estella,waltz)).
% Aileen has stage experience.
axiom(s24, has(aileen,stage_experience)).
% If Bunny teaches dance, then she either loves salsa or enjoys tango, but not both.
axiom(s25, rule([teaches(bunny,dance)], xor(loves(bunny,salsa), enjoys(bunny,tango)))).
% Estella dances samba.
axiom(s26, dances(estella,samba)).","query":"labelled_explanation(not(dislikes(aileen,tango)), Status, Package)"}
